originalTitle: Will a commercially available device incorporate a room-temperature, ambient pressure superconductor by 2030?
title: 2030 年前是否出现常压高于 0 °C 的超导商品？
Will a commercial device use ambient-pressure superconductivity above 0 °C before 2030?
rules: 要求可商业获得的设备使用常压、高于 0 °C、无需主动冷却的超导体。
Requires a commercially available device using ambient-pressure superconductors above 0 °C without active cooling.
interpretation: 这是商业器件事件，不限 LK-99。高于 0 °C 也与另一个市场的 0–30 °C 范围不同。
This device contract is not limited to LK-99; above 0 °C differs from another contract’s 0–30 °C range.

summary: 预测 2030 年前出现可商业获得的特定超导器件；门槛比“发现一种材料”更靠后。
This asks about a commercially obtainable qualifying device before 2030, a later milestone than material discovery.
checklist: 同时核对常压、高于 0 °C 和无需主动冷却。
Check ambient pressure, above 0 °C and no active cooling together.
确认商品实际可获得，排除只有实验室演示的样品。
Verify commercial availability rather than a lab-only demonstration.
查器件所用材料和实际运行条件。
Identify the material and actual device operating conditions.

stage: 材料复现 → 导体加工 → 器件商品
impact: SuperPower 已有低温 REBCO 线材产品，说明超导产业存在制造和客户应用链条；但官网条件仍需低温。独立实验对材料前提的检验，比把既有“高温超导”产品误读成常温突破更贴近这些题目。

SuperPower demonstrates an existing cryogenic REBCO supply chain, not an ambient-temperature breakthrough. Independent material tests are more relevant to these premises than the label high-temperature.
gap: 没有资料表明该企业采用 LK-99，或其线材符合原题高于 0 °C、常压、无需主动冷却条件。论文出现、复现成功、商品销售和条件市场取消分别判断。
No cited source establishes LK-99 adoption or above-0 °C uncooled operation. Paper appearance, replication, sales and conditional cancellation remain separate outcomes.

title: 材料发现与无需冷却的商品，是不同终点
A material discovery and an uncooled commercial device are different endpoints
principle: 超导验证需要在约定温度、压力下审查电输运与磁响应，不能只看“电阻降低”或悬浮视频。器件还需要可用电流、磁场范围、机械加工和稳定运行；临界条件一旦超过，材料可能退出超导态。

Evidence must address transport and magnetic response at the specified temperature and pressure, rather than a resistance decrease or levitation video alone. Devices also need usable current/field ranges, processing and stable operation; exceeding critical conditions can destroy superconductivity.
example: DOE 所介绍的超导磁体应用说明超导已有实际用途，但原市场额外要求常压、0 °C 以上和无需主动冷却，既有低温设备不能直接满足它。基础发现题的 No 或短期器件题的 No，也不是“此后永远不可能”的结论。

Existing superconducting magnets demonstrate real applications, but do not satisfy the extra ambient-pressure, above-0 °C and no-active-cooling requirements here. A No on a short-deadline contract is not a claim of permanent impossibility.
